page: Microsoft Azure E32ps_v5 is an ARM64-based virtual machine belonging to the EPSv5 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores powered by an Ampere Altra ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor operating at 3.0 GHz. The CPU configuration includes a 64 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache, with single-threaded execution per core. It is equipped with 208.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.5 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Performance benchmarks place the E32ps_v5 in the average tier across most standardized tests. The stress-ng single-core score is 1822.48, and the multi-core score reaches 57228.38. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 2231.83 GB/sec, while large block uncached read and write speeds are 171.35 GB/sec and 77.34 GB/sec, respectively. In database operations, the server achieves a PassMark database score of 21174.02 and handles 42.33 million Redis SET operations per second.

A notable performance tradeoff is observed in single-threaded bzip3 decompression, which registers a weak score of 8.9 GB/sec, though multi-threaded decompression recovers to an average 74.22 GB/sec. Large-model LLM inference is also a limitation, with the 70B model processing prompts at 3.6 tokens/sec and generating text at 2.45 tokens/sec, categorized as poor. However, the server performs reliably on smaller models, static web serving at 32.76 GB/sec, and software compilation with a Geekbench clang score of 28277.0. This profile makes the E32ps_v5 highly cost-efficient for memory-intensive ARM-native workloads, database operations, and web serving, rather than heavy AI inference or single-threaded decompression tasks.
